title: Production
summary: Where the kitchen records what it makes in batches (gelato, a base, syrup, dough): the day's plan of what to make, recording a batch, the batches in stock with their use-by, labels for the pans, and marking down what must be sold today.

who.cannot: add or change recipes (needs recipe.edit)

who.cannot: record a batch, mark down, change anything

get_there: Menu → Operations → Production. A barista starts here after signing in. Also: Getting set up's link (/production#new-recipe) opens the add-recipe panel; a 'Record these' link in the plan opens the form filled in.
before: Stock items exist (Inventory) for the ingredients, ideally with a cost (a delivery or opening stock), or batches are costed at 0 for them.
At least one batch recipe is set up under 'What you make' (by the owner or general manager).
With more than one place: the device is set to the place where the batch is made ('Stock at' at the top). Batches are recorded, planned and kept at that place.

parts.name: Top of the screen
parts.shows: The heading 'Production', the place switch (only when the café has two or more places), a one-line explanation with 'How this works' to open the rest, and for those who see costs a link to the waste report. A first-time visitor sees the tour offer.

controls.label: Stock at
controls.does: Chooses which of the café's places this device works at. The whole page reloads for that place: its plan, its stock, its batches.
controls.rules: Shown only with two or more places. Kept on this device for a year.
controls.after: Every batch recorded afterwards on this device is recorded at the chosen place.

controls.label: How this works
controls.does: Opens or closes the full explanation of the screen.

controls.label: Waste by recipe: made, sold and thrown away →
controls.does: Opens Reports → Waste.

controls.label: Show me around
controls.does: Starts a 5-step tour: the day's plan, the plan in one go, Record a batch, what is in stock, the recipes. Steps: Next, Back, Finish, End the tour.
controls.rules: The offer 'New here? Let us show you around this screen.' shows once per device until taken or refused. The menu's 'Show me around this screen' starts it again any time.

controls.label: No thanks
controls.does: Hides the tour offer on this device.

parts.name: Sell it before it goes
parts.shows: Shown only when something must be sold today, or a markdown is running. Each batch whose use-by ends before the café's day ends, with some left: the item, '{left} left, use by {time}', each size on the menu that sells it with '{n} to sell' (servings left). Below, 'Marked down now': each running markdown, '{percent}% off', 'until {time}'.

controls.label: {percent}% off · {price}
controls.does: Marks every size that sells this batch down by that percentage until the café's day ends. The first button is the suggested one (50% with two hours or less left, 30% with five hours or less, else 20%); the others are 20%, 30% and 50%. The price shown is the first size's take-away (or dine-in) price after the markdown.
controls.rules: 5% to 90%, whole percent. A size already marked down is replaced by the new percentage.
controls.who: Those who approve discounts or record production (owner, general manager, branch manager, barista).
controls.after: The till sells those sizes at the lower price until midnight (café time) at this place, and shows by how much. Each markdown is on the audit trail. End of Day and the Dashboard show it.

controls.label: Stop
controls.does: Ends that markdown now: the till goes back to the usual price.
controls.after: On the audit trail.

parts.name: Ordered ahead
parts.shows: Shown only when customers have open pre-orders. By the day they are collected, soonest first (today says 'Today'; a past day is red): the time, the order number, the customer, and each line 'qty × product (size)' with its note in quotes, then the order's note.

parts.name: Record a batch
parts.shows: Shown to those who record production. The form to record one batch (or several of one recipe). Below the fields, a preview: 'Uses' lists each ingredient with how much this many batches take and, for those who see stock, '{qty} in stock' or, in red, 'only {qty} in stock'; 'Makes' says '{qty} of {output}' with '— as the recipe says', or how much less or more than the recipe it is; for those who see costs, 'Cost {amount} · {amount} per {unit}'.

controls.label: What did you make?
controls.does: Chooses the recipe. Changing it clears 'What came out' and sets its unit to the recipe's.
controls.rules: Only recipes in use ('Stop making it' removes one). Filled from the plan's 'Record these' link when used.

controls.label: Batches
controls.does: How many batches were made. 1.5 is allowed.
controls.rules: A number above 0. Starts at 1, or at the plan's number when opened from the plan.

controls.label: What came out (optional)
controls.does: What really came out, if it was weighed or counted. Left empty, the recipe's amount is used (shown in grey inside the box).

controls.label: Unit of what came out
controls.does: The unit of 'What came out': the item's base unit and its other units (kg, a pan, …).
controls.rules: Starts at the recipe's yield unit.

controls.label: Note (optional)
controls.does: A note kept with the batch, e.g. 'a little thick, left to rest'. Shown under the recipe name in the Batches list.

controls.label: Use by (optional)
controls.does: A date and time to use it by, when not the recipe's shelf life. The hint under it says what happens when it is left empty: 'Left empty: {n} day(s) from when it is made, as its recipe keeps.', or '… {n} hour(s) …', or 'Left empty: no use-by, as its recipe keeps no shelf life.'
controls.rules: Must be after the time it was made.

controls.label: Made earlier: yesterday or today, recorded now
controls.does: Opens two more boxes: 'When it was made' (date and time) and 'Why it is recorded late' (e.g. 'made before opening, recorded now'). The note under them says: 'Not before the last approved count of its items.'
controls.rules: Not before yesterday 00:00. A reason is required.
controls.who: Managers only (inventory.adjust.approve: owner, general manager, branch manager).

controls.label: Record batch
controls.does: Checks the form, then records the batch in one step: takes each ingredient out of stock at what it costs now, puts what came out into stock as a new batch lot (batch number B{no}) at the total cost of the ingredients, and sets its use-by. Shows 'Recording…' while it works.
controls.rules: Disabled until a recipe and a number of batches above 0 are given. Ingredients are taken by the recipe in force on the day it was made.
controls.after: Stock: ingredients go down, the made item goes up (Inventory, stock card, Production 'In stock by batch'). Money and books: no journal; the value only moves inside 1200 Inventory. Over-the-books use with a manager's approval goes on the audit trail. The batch appears in the Batches list and on Reports → Production / Waste. A late batch is marked 'recorded late'.

controls.label: Labels
controls.does: Appears after a batch is recorded: how many pan labels to print. Starts at one label a pan (when the batch was entered in pans or another container unit), else 1.

controls.label: Print {n} label(s)
controls.does: Prints that many labels on the receipt printer (80 mm), each cut on its own: the café's name, what is in the pan, 'Batch {no}' and 'Pan {i} of {n}', 'Made' with weekday and time, 'Use by' boxed (or 'No use-by'), and 'The batch made {made}' with the place and who made it.

controls.label: Manager / Choose your name
controls.does: Shown under 'A manager approves using more than the books hold, with their PIN:' when an ingredient's rule asks for a manager. Lists who may approve with a PIN set.
controls.who: Any person recording; the approver must be someone else.

controls.label: Their PIN
controls.does: The approving manager types their PIN (4 to 8 digits). Enter approves.

controls.label: Approve
controls.does: Checks the manager's PIN and, if right, records the batch again with that approval (good once, for ten minutes).
controls.after: The approval and who gave it go on the audit trail.

parts.name: What to make on {weekday}, {day}
parts.shows: The day's plan for this place. A line explains how it is worked out: from what each was sold, used in batches or sent elsewhere on the same weekday over the last 4 to 8 weeks, on average, less what is on hand and still good at the end of the day, in whole batches. When the plan learns, it adds: it makes more of what sold out on half those days or more and was never thrown away, and less of what was thrown away on half or more and never sold out, never below one batch. Columns: What (with '↑ Sold out {n} of the last {weeks} weeks: makes {qty} more' or '↓ Thrown away {n} of the last {weeks} weeks, about {avg} a time: makes {qty} less'), Used on the day, on average ('over {n} weeks', or '{n} day(s) of history: 28 are needed' / 'No history yet: 28 days are needed'), On hand, Due before the day is out, To make ('{n} batch(es): {qty}', or a badge 'Enough on hand' / 'Not enough history'). Under the table, when ingredients are short: 'Short for these batches: {list}. What to buy'.

controls.label: Today
controls.does: Shows today's plan.

controls.label: Tomorrow
controls.does: Shows tomorrow's plan.

controls.label: Record these
controls.does: Opens the Record a batch form filled in with that recipe and number of batches, to check and record.
controls.who: Those who record production; only for recipes in use.

controls.label: What to buy
controls.does: Opens Purchasing → What to buy.

parts.name: Record the plan in one go
parts.shows: A fold-out under the plan, for those who record production, when the plan has batches to make. Each row is a recipe the plan says to make, ticked, with its batches filled in; a base comes before the flavours made from it. After recording, each row says '✓ Recorded as batch {no}: {made} of {output} into stock. Use it by {when}.' or 'Not recorded: {why}'. When the ticked batches differ from the plan and some ingredient is short: 'Short for these batches: {list}.'

controls.label: Make {name}
controls.does: Untick what was not made; it is left out.

controls.label: Batches of {name}
controls.does: How many batches were made.
controls.rules: A number above 0, else 'Enter how many batches, as a number above 0.'

controls.label: What came out of {name}
controls.does: What came out, if it differs from the recipe; empty means as the recipe says.
controls.rules: A number above 0 or empty, else 'Enter what came out as a number, or leave it empty.'

controls.label: Unit of what came out of {name}
controls.does: Its unit.

controls.label: Record {n} batch(es)
controls.does: Records each ticked row one after another, each as its own batch with its own key ('Recording {i} of {n}…'). Each is checked as the single form checks it. Nothing is recorded twice if the connection drops.
controls.rules: Disabled while any ticked row has a mistake. No late batches, notes or use-by dates here: use the single form for those.
controls.after: As 'Record batch', once for each row.

controls.label: Record it on its own
controls.does: On a row that was refused: opens the single form filled in with that recipe, to fix and record (e.g. with a manager's approval).

controls.label: Print {n} label(s)
controls.does: Prints every label of every batch just recorded, one a pan.

parts.name: In stock by batch
parts.shows: Each batch lot with something left at this place, the one to use first at the top: Batch (links to the batch's page), What, Still in stock, Use by with a badge: 'Past its use-by' (red), 'Due today', 'Due within a day', 'Good'. Note: 'Sales take the batch to be used first first; one past its use-by last.'

controls.label: Change the use-by…
controls.does: Opens a date-and-time box, a 'Why the use-by changes' box (e.g. 'it set soft, sell it today'), 'Save the use-by' and 'Cancel'.

controls.label: Save the use-by
controls.does: Saves the new use-by for that batch with the reason.
controls.rules: A reason is required; the use-by must be after the batch was made.
controls.after: The lot's order of use and its badge change; the Dashboard's 'Expiring soon' and markdown suggestions follow. On the audit trail with the reason.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.does: Closes the use-by form without saving.

parts.name: Batches
parts.shows: The last 50 batches: Batch number (opens the batch's page), Made (with a 'recorded late' badge when so; its reason shows on hover), What (with its note, and for a cancelled batch 'cancelled', the reason and who), Batches, Came out (with '−/+ {qty} on the recipe' when it differs), Still in stock, Use by, Cost (and the cost per unit; only for those who see costs), By.

controls.label: Cancel…
controls.does: Opens a 'Why it is cancelled' box (e.g. 'recorded twice'), 'Cancel the batch' and 'Keep it'.

controls.label: Cancel the batch
controls.does: Cancels the batch: puts every ingredient back into stock and takes what it made out, at the values first recorded.
controls.rules: A reason is required. Refused if any of what it made has already been used, sold or moved.
controls.after: Stock: reversed. The batch shows 'cancelled' and stays in the list. On the audit trail.

controls.label: Keep it
controls.does: Closes the cancel form; nothing changes.

(or, for those who cannot edit recipes, 'A manager who edits recipes adds what you make.'). Record a batch says 'Nothing to record yet: first add what you make, below.'
Batches shows 'No batches yet' — 'Every batch recorded is listed here.'
'Nothing is made here yet.' under the plan's explanation.

states.state: Sell it before it goes, shown
states.looks: Only when a batch's use-by ends today with some left, or a markdown runs.
The 'Stock at' switch is shown; everything is for the chosen place.

what_if.case: The batch came out lighter than the recipe says
what_if.do: Type what you weighed in 'What came out (optional)' with its unit. The preview shows '— {diff} less than the recipe's {planned}'. Record it: stock gets what really came out, at the full cost of the ingredients.

what_if.case: I made it this morning before opening and forgot to record it
what_if.do: A manager ticks 'Made earlier: yesterday or today, recorded now', gives the time and why, and records it. Not possible if a count of its items was approved after that time, or before yesterday.

what_if.case: An ingredient shows 'only … in stock'
what_if.do: Usually a delivery is not entered. Enter it on Purchasing first. If the item's rule allows it, a manager can approve using more with their PIN; if it refuses, record the delivery or count it first.

what_if.case: A batch was recorded twice by mistake
what_if.do: A manager presses 'Cancel…' on the second one in Batches, types 'recorded twice', and 'Cancel the batch'. If some of it was already sold or used, record the rest as a loss on Inventory instead.

what_if.case: A batch went soft and must be sold today
what_if.do: A manager uses 'Change the use-by…' in In stock by batch, gives today's time and the reason. It then appears under 'Sell it before it goes', where it can be marked down.

what_if.case: Ice cream from today's batch will not sell before closing
what_if.do: In 'Sell it before it goes', press the suggested '{percent}% off' button. The till sells it cheaper until the day ends. Press Stop to end it early.

what_if.case: The plan says 'Not enough history'
what_if.do: It needs 28 days of sales and use. Until then, decide yourself how many to make.

what_if.case: We made the whole plan this morning
what_if.do: Open 'Record the plan in one go', untick what was not made, change what came out where it differs, press 'Record {n} batch(es)', then 'Print {n} label(s)'.

tips: The plan's 'Record these' fills in the form for you; you still check and press Record batch.
Leave 'What came out' empty when it came out as the recipe says.
Labels start at one per pan when the batch is entered in pans; you can change the number before printing.
A base recorded first is available at once for the flavours made from it; the plan in one go records bases first.
Sales use the batch with the earliest use-by first, and a batch past its use-by last.
Open a batch number to see what became of it.

messages.text: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
messages.when: The sign-in ran out while the screen was open.
messages.do: Sign in again, then repeat the last step.

messages.text: You do not have permission to do this (needs {permission})
messages.when: The database refused the change because the person's role does not hold that permission (for example a screen left open after a role changed).
messages.do: Ask the owner to check your role on Staff, or ask someone who holds it.

messages.text: The database is missing an update this screen needs (a migration has not been applied yet).
messages.when: The app is newer than the database: a database update has not been applied.
messages.do: Tell the owner or whoever runs the system; nothing was saved.

skipped_messages.text: This screen sent no retry key: reload the page and try again.
skipped_messages.reason: Only when the page's code is out of date or broken; every button on this screen sends a key.

skipped_messages.text: This retry does not match what was first sent: reload the page and check before doing it again
skipped_messages.reason: Only when a stuck submission is changed and sent again with the old key; the screen gives a new key after a definite answer, so a person rarely meets it. If seen: reload and check.

skipped_messages.text: This was sent by someone else
skipped_messages.reason: Retry keys belong to one person; cannot happen from a normal screen.

skipped_messages.reason: Shown by the sign-in screens, not here: a page without a sign-in is sent to the sign-in screen first.
